scientific_integrity: Analytical theorem for all compact K and admissible countable A; no external certification. Fixed-operator normal spectral criteria are prior work, not presented as novel.
scientific_limitations: Only positive invertible self-adjoint realizations with K within [1,2] and separable complex Hilbert spaces; does not classify nonnormal or Banach-space patterns. Finite arithmetic checker does not prove infinite theorem; prior equivalence remains a residual risk.
title: Universality of scalar asymptotic-expansivity phase diagrams for normal dynamics
